title: VMware Horizon View loggerBean Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of VMware Horizon View. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the loggerBean service. The loadConfig method does not properly sanitize the path supplied. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose arbitrary files from the system.
